title: Zigzag Text Generator
description: Render your text in a diagonal zigzag (rail-fence) pattern — real ASCII art with adjustable rows and spacing.
howto: Type your text (short phrases work best).
Set the number of zigzag rows and the spacing between letters.
Copy the ASCII-art result from the preview box.

faqs.a: The letters bounce diagonally between rows like a "W" repeated — the same layout as the rail-fence cipher, rendered as fixed-width ASCII art.

faqs.q: Why does my long text look cramped?
faqs.a: Zigzag art needs horizontal room. Use fewer rows, shorter text, or copy it into a wider area (a code block or document).

faqs.q: Does it work with any characters?
faqs.a: Yes — letters, digits and symbols all follow the zigzag path. Emoji may misalign because they are wider than one column.
